newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Shenzhen B shares retreat on profit-taking.
newsitem.headline: Shenzhen B shares retreat on profit-taking.

text.p: Shenzhen's B share index fell on Tuesday on profit-taking after steep rises over the past few sessions, brokers said.

The B index fell 4.26 points, or 2.15 percent, to end at 193.87 after hitting an intraday high of 201.87 and a low of 191.11. Turnover was HK$724.79 million compared with HK$779.22 million the previous session.
Brokers said profit-taking hit counters that had seen strong gains recently. They said resistance was seen at the 200-point level over the short term.
The market needs time to consolidate before testing the 200-point psychological barrier, one analyst said.
He added that institutions might later this month start building positions in the shares of companies expected to report solid results for 1996.
Guangdong Power was the biggest loser, falling HK$0.60, or 7.89 percent, to HK$7.00 on volume of 3.62 million shares.
Gujing Distillery fell HK$0.80, or 6.67 percent, to HK$11.20 on trade of 3.61 shares. China Bicycle traded the most on volume of 6.54 million shares and fell HK$0.20 to HK$5.65.
Diesel engine maker Changchai fell HK$0.40 to HK$8.20 on the day's second most active trade of 6.08 million shares.
Changan Automobile lost HK$0.17 to HK$6.18 on trading of 6.05 million shares, due in part to profit-taking by institutions, brokers said.
Floppy disk maker Benelux bucked the trend, rising HK$0.38, or 5.49 percent, to HK$7.30 on volume of 658,450 shares because of speculative buying, brokers said.
The A share market also eased on a correction, brokers said. The A index shed 3.87 points, or 0.79 percent, to 487.16 on turnover of 14.01 billion yuan against Monday's 15 billion.
The composite index lost 4.03 points, or 0.86 percent, to 463.76.
Five firms listed a total of 55.11 million A shares in Shenzhen on Tuesday, which led to a diversion of funds out of other issues, brokers said.
Retailer Shaanxi Minsheng plunged 0.56 yuan, or 5.62 percent, to 9.40 yuan on volume of 9.51 million shares due to profit-taking.
Textile issue Zhuhai Fuhua dropped 0.40 yuan, or 4.66 percent, to 8.18 yuan as 11 million shares changed hands.
